content.title: Tar Heels head basketball coach Hubert Davis out after 5 seasons at the helm of the program
content.text: The video above is a live stream of WBTV and affiliated programming, and may not be directly related to the article below.On Tuesday, March 24, the University of North Carolina and head coach Hubert Davis decided to part ways after five disappointing seasons.North Carolina is one of the premier blue-blood programs in the nation. The job opening could have ripple effects across the head coaching landscape in college basketball. Despite Davis posting a 125-54 record during his five seasons, postseason success just wasn’t there. The Tar Heels are coming off back-to-back losses in the first round of the men’s NCAA tournament, including a blown 19-point lead to Virginia Commonwealth last weekend.Davis did make it to the national championship game in his first season, 2021-2022. However, North Carolina blew the biggest lead in championship game history. Kansas erased a 16-point deficit to win its fourth title in program history that season.The Tar Heels can hang their hat on eliminating their arch rival, Duke University, in the Final Four during Davis’ tenure. They sent legendary Duke head coach Mike Krzyzewski out with an 81-77 loss.Duke has gone 7-2 under head coach Jon Scheyer against the Tar Heels. Duke has reached the Sweet Sixteen of the tournament for the third straight season in 2025-2026. But the Tar Heels can say they eliminated Krzyzewski in his final season and finished as national runner-up.The Blue Devils will face St. John’s on Friday, March 27, which can be watched on WBTV. Read --> No. 11 seed VCU overcomes 19-point deficit to upset No. 6 seed Tar HeelsHowever, since the national title run in 2021-2022, the Tar Heels have underperformed in the postseason.In the Atlantic Coast Conference, Davis reached one tournament championship game, in 2024 — an 84-76 loss to a red-hot North Carolina State team. The Tar Heels also won the regular-season ACC championship that season, the only one under Davis’ leadership.During that time, the Blue Devils have won the regular-season title three times, including back-to-back seasons in 2025 and 2026. Duke has also won the ACC tournament three times.The Tar Heels were the No. 1-ranked team to start the 2022-2023 season. They returned four of five starters from the championship game, including Armando Bacot. But North Carolina missed the tournament completely.In the 2023-2024 season, North Carolina made it to the Sweet 16 as a No. 1 seed before being eliminated by Alabama.Davis and the Tar Heels then lost in back-to-back seasons in the first round of the men’s NCAA tournament: last season to Ole Miss, 71-64, and this season after blowing a 19-point lead to Virginia Commonwealth.The school on Thursday night said that they would honor the terms of Davis’ contract. They did not go into detail into what those terms were. The team didn’t say who would be replacing him. It is expected to be one of the biggest job openings this offseason and could attract a lot of big names. Copyright 2026 WBTV. All rights reserved.
